title: 4 sites. 40 calls.
One phone.
scenes.vo: Four construction sites. Forty phone calls a day. Here's how one contractor in Hyderabad runs all of it from one phone.
One full day, four sites. Let's go.

title: Attendance,
done.
scenes.vo: Nine A M. The supervisor punches in the gang with G P S. Ten seconds.

title: Cement arrives.
Stock updates.
scenes.vo: Eleven A M. Cement arrives. The delivery is checked against the order, and stock updates itself.

title: Too busy
to type?
scenes.ask: Add ₹5,000 spent on cement at Kompally
scenes.reply: Sure, Ravi. Here it is for Kompally Villa.
scenes.card: Expense ₹5,000 for Material at Kompally Villa, Block B · cement
scenes.final: Saved ₹5,000 for cement at Kompally Villa.
scenes.vo: One P M. No time to type. Just say it. Add five thousand for cement at Kompally. Tap save. Done.

title: Plan
tomorrow.
scenes.ask: Add a task: plaster the first floor by Friday
scenes.reply: Here is the task for Kompally Villa.
scenes.card: Task: Plaster first floor · due Fri 13 Nov · Kompally Villa
scenes.final: Added. I will remind you on Friday morning.
scenes.vo: Four P M. Plan tomorrow. Add a task, plaster the first floor by Friday.

title: Daily report,
spoken.
scenes.vo: Six P M. The engineer speaks the day's report, and shares it on WhatsApp with the client.

title: The owner's
brief.
scenes.vo: Seven thirty P M. The owner gets one brief. Two sites need attention: one has no report, one is over budget.

scenes.label: Saturday wages for 12 workers
scenes.vo: Saturday. Wages for every worker, added up. Days, half days, overtime. No arguments.

title: Who you owe,
oldest first.
scenes.vo: Month end. Who you owe, oldest first, before a supplier stops your credit.

title: Know before
it's too late.
scenes.vo: And every day, the dashboard warns you before a site goes over budget.
All of it in Telugu, Hindi or English. On a basic Android phone.
